Calibrating Hedonic Pricing Model for Private Highrise Property with GWR Method

Getting Started

```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, spdep, GWmodel, SpatialML, tmap,rsample, Metrics, tidyverse, knitr, kableExtra, spatialRF, randomForestExplainer)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1234)
HDB_sample <- mdata %>%
sample_n(1500)
```

```{r}
overlapping_points <- HDB_sample %>%
mutate(overlap = lengths(st_equals(., .)) > 1)
```

```{r}
HDB_sample <- HDB_sample %>%
st_jitter(amount = 1)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1234)
resale_split <- initial_split(HDB_sample,
prop = 6.67/10,)
train_data <- training(resale_split)
test_data <- testing(resale_split)
```
